statements.new_statement_en: More people should qualify for disability, nursing-care and sick-leave benefits, for example homemakers and the self-employed, even if National Insurance and employers pay more.

reason: All weighty bills expand eligibility in one family: work-injury pay for the self-employed (1,10,12,15), disability (3,5,6,18,22,27,30,32,40 and others), nursing care without income tests (9,13,14,20,21,24,31,33,34) and sick days for a sick child or family member (2,4,8,16,23,28,29). The statement fits, but about a third of the weight (the sick-leave bills) is paid by employers under the Sick Pay Law, not by National Insurance, so the stated price is incomplete. Smallest change: name both payers. Key unchanged (agree = more eligibility). Rows 11 (psychological treatment for terror victims) and 25 (polio compensation) are separate compensation schemes; their weight is light.
